observedAt.description: Time this presence reading was determined (freshness anchor); always present even when state is unknown.

lastSeenAt.description: Last actual device contact time. null when the device has never been seen; the key is always present (stable column set, #1875).

tenantId.description: Device's tenant (framework-produced for multi-tenant routing). null until a device→tenant binding source supplies it — the serving producer honestly omits it rather than back-fill the caller's JWT tenant (the caller's tenant is not the device's). The key is always present (stable column set, #1875/#2359).
